From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha@greenhouselabs.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot slab + deferred billing for GreenhouseLabs cohort

Hi Marissa & Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost controls. We have a cohort of 20 early-stage founders kicking off in May and are hoping to include Redwood as the recommended inference provider for their qualifying projects.

Two asks from our side:
- A one-time pilot slab of free credits (we estimate ~$8k consumption over 6 weeks) to cover initial prototypes and demo nights.
- Deferred billing for committed consumption during the 6-week cohort (invoice due 60 days after cohort close) — this helps our founders convert without upfront friction.

This is the kind of program where we can surface Redwood in our partner newsletter and invite you to the demo day (good marketing ROI). Any flexibility on packaging or a short-term promotional exception would help us get this in the cohort prospectus.

Happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Partnerships, Greenhouse Labs
[Attachment: cohort-outline.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the intro to the cohort (looks exciting).

Quick thoughts:
- Pilot slab: we can approve a one-time credit slab. Need to lock an expected consumption range and a conversion trigger (e.g., founders convert to paid within 90 days of cohort end) to qualify.
- Deferred billing: finance will need to sign off on 60-day terms for cohort invoices; we do offer short exception windows for ecosystem partners.

Ben — looping you in for sizing/discount and Laura in finance if we should finalize terms as a short addendum.

Aisha, can you share the cohort intake doc (who are the teams, rough usage per project) and the preferred timing for the invoice? If you want, we can draft a short pilot addendum to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Startup & Accelerator Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Kapoor <aisha@greenhouselabs.io>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot slab + deferred billing for GreenhouseLabs cohort

Aisha — nice to meet you over email. Couple of practicals from sales side:

- If you expect ~20 teams and ~ $8k total consumption during pilot, we can offer a $8,000 credit slab tied to the cohort id.
- We typically require usage reporting and a 10% overage guardrail (i.e., we auto-notify when consumption reaches 90%).
- For deferred payment: standard is Net30; Finance will consider Net60 for this partner if we add a revenue-share clause (5% of paid conversion ARR credited back as co-marketing) or a small deposit from Greenhouse Labs (e.g., $1,000) to offset credit risk.

Marissa — can you loop in Laura for finance and Karthik for partner ops to confirm whether revenue-share is a go or whether Greenhouse will do the deposit?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-pilot-tc.pdf (application/pdf)]

Marissa / team — reviewed the ask and the numbers. Finance is comfortable with Net60 for a one-off partner cohort if both of the following are implemented:
1) A $1,000 refundable deposit from Greenhouse Labs OR a signed co-marketing commitment (min. 1x newsletter mention + demo day co-sponsor slot) and
2) A 5% conversion revenue-share credit that is applied as a marketing credit against future invoices for any founders who convert to paid Redwood accounts within 180 days.

If Greenhouse can confirm either the deposit or the formal co-marketing deliverable, we will prepare a short addendum (SOW + payment terms) to be routed via DocuSign. Ben — please prepare the pricing addendum and I will review T&C redlines.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
